# StudyCod

Tagline: learn by building.

StudyCod is a programming-learning platform built around practice, debugging, guided hints, and measurable progress.

- [Home](https://studycod.space/): StudyCod programming practice platform.
- [Documentation](https://studycod.space/docs): Product documentation and guides.
- [Pricing](https://studycod.space/pricing): Plans and pricing information.
- [Privacy policy](https://studycod.space/privacy): Privacy policy.
- [Terms of use](https://studycod.space/terms): Terms of use.
